battlefield.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original Royal Fantasy Warfare gameplay visual target, a top-down shallow orthographic 2D game battlefield, landscape 1536x1024. Reference supplied is ONLY the shape/material/lighting benchmark: adapt its ROYAL blue-and-gold leftmost world. Premium Heroic Toy-Stylized American cartoon game finish, chunky wide rounded masses, obvious broad bevels, 65% clean large regions, limited secondary details, no photorealistic noise. Design an original LOW WIDE stone and timber fortress at exact image center (x50%, y52%), taking only 16% image width and 24% image height, with thick blue enamel protective roof plate and original split-diamond insignia. No crown, no existing game tower silhouette. Main color muted blue #4365A0, warm brass #D7A857, simplified stone #A4A59B, clean timber #956F4D, quiet grass #83AD70. Four broad sandy approach routes form a diagonal X from the four image corners toward the central keep. Middle 75% of map is very low-detail quiet flat grass and clear paths, lower environment contrast than keep. Reserve four EMPTY clear circular grass zones at x25/y30, x75/y30, x25/y72, x75/y72 for interactive future tower placement; NO towers or pads baked there. Perimeter has thick soft-faceted fort walls, very sparse chunky conifers, barrels and broad flags, confined to outermost 10% of frame. Gentle upper-left key light, readable soft fill, contact shadows. No horizon, no camera tilt into perspective vanishing point, no busy flowers, no dense grass blades. No characters, no enemies, no target words, no labels, no healthbars, no controls or UI baked into image. This is a functional castle-defense map for a children's typing game, playable region must remain quiet and readable, physical heroic royal theme distinctly different from magical botanical fairytale.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: five-world style benchmark panorama for an original keyboard-learning adventure game, not final gameplay sprites. Create a wide landscape 1536x1024 image, divided compositionally into FIVE equal vertical territories WITHOUT drawn separators, captions or text. Each territory has its own miniature diorama and one full-body original hero, all from the SAME premium Heroic Toy-Stylized American animated GAME visual family: one dominant chunky mass plus 2-4 readable secondary masses, broad bevels, 3-head-high stylized bodies, large expressive eyebrows, exaggerated functional gear, warm upper-left key light with broad clean material highlights and grounding shadows. Large clean color areas, restricted ornament, rich controlled midtones; no photographic noise, no watercolor, no line-art, no excessive candy gloss. Left to right: 1 Royal fantasy warfare: broad short sturdy guard with oversized geometric kite shield, NOT crown, blue enamel #4365A0 and warm gold #D7A857, thick warm stone and timber bastion, original split-diamond crest. 2 Science fiction: round capsule-armored robot ranger with cyan energy ring and modular space outpost, blue #3E66B0 cyan #36B7C9 dark slate. 3 Modern: cheerful chunky engineer with safety helmet, big gloves and utility toolbox, miniature friendly city workshop, petrol blue #477F98 and amber #E0AE51. 4 Ancient: bronze-and-jade guardian with exaggerated stepped shield and sun-disc ornament, thick tapered sandstone columns, ochre #AB7C48 jade #5C9182. 5 Fairytale: appealing mushroom-helmet forest guardian with large leaf shield and crystal flower, soft organic S-curves and bulbous foliage, lavender #936CC4 green #7AB78A. All five character faces original and distinct, silhouettes comparable weight but theme identities unmistakable. Lower half hero focus, upper half themed architecture silhouettes. No existing game characters, no recognizable crowns or existing tower designs, no card frames, no UI, no words, no watermark. Purpose: visual art direction specimen, charming, heroic, playful, child-friendly.
